source_chart_summary: Figure 1 is a 100% stacked vertical bar chart titled 'Companies plan to offer more benefits in five years.' answering the question 'In five years, do you think your company will be offering fewer, the same or more benefits than it does now?'. It shows three series ('Fewer benefits' in light gray, 'About the same' in dark gray, and 'More benefits' in yellow) across three employer size categories: Small (10–99 employees) with 3%, 40%, 57% and callout '+7% change from 2023'; Midsize (100–999 employees) with 1%, 35%, 64% and callout '+6% change from 2023'; and Large (1,000 or more employees) with 3%, 30%, 67% and callout '+5% change from 2023'.
